The FCC certification also covers the [[Furrion FAN17B8B]] which is internally :identical but does not include the ceiling mount bracket that is included :with this [[Furrion FAN17B83]]. <small> Chip IDs are not visible in the FCC photos. Although one of the FCC documents mentions :the [[Realtek]] RTL8192EE, the CPU looks like a [[MediaTek MT7621AT]] with its rectangular :shape and the radios could be a MT7602EN and a MT7612EN. :A possible third radio is visible next to the Mini PCIe cellular card. </small> *[[Novatel Wireless LP53]] PCIe module provides the LTE cellular connection. :LTE: B2/B4/B13, GPS
